market_view: Rebound morning after a hot CPI. Tuesday's core CPI came in at +0.3% against +0.2% expected, the 10-year yield touched 5% and SPY closed -0.4% at 749.92 (QQQ -0.7%, IWM -0.7%). After the close CoreWeave beat and raised its guidance, and at 6:40 ET the Nasdaq-100 futures are +1.9% with NVDA +5%, AMD +6.5% and TSM +5% pre-market; SPY is +0.9% at 756.50 and the VIX is 18.6. The US bond market is closed for Veterans Day, so there is no yield signal today. WTI is US$86.60, gold US$4,062, BTC US$73,960 with Fear & Greed at 29. The desk's week so far: Fox +C$984 realized (his crude short is open and under water), Dax +C$108, Sam +C$40, Vega -C$809 after three option stops and a day-loss halt on Tuesday.

shared_notes: Chips gap up on CoreWeave after a hot CPI: the first hour decides whether the gap holds (QQQ 684) or fades (680).
Vega lost C$809 on three option stops Tuesday and was halted at -20%: today she is limited to one trade and a 12% day loss.
The bond market is closed today: Tuesday's rate fear (10-year near 5%) is on pause, not gone.
Option orders go live at 9:45 ET; Vega and Theo meet at 9:31 on live quotes first.

day.view: Tuesday paid: KULR gave me half at 1R and the rest at target (+C$181), PXLW added C$14, and ZNTL cost C$62 at its stop, so I'm +C$108 on the week and the no-chase rule held. Today chips gap on CoreWeave, which wakes up the small AI and quantum names. I take what opens 8% up on 3x volume and holds above VWAP, inside half an R of its range high. A gap day fades fast if the Nasdaq loses 680, so after one loser on a fading tape I slow down. Greenfire stays on the avoid list.

playbook.then: buy the break, stop under the range low, half off at 1R, the rest at 1.5R

playbook.if: the breakout is already more than 0.5R past its level
playbook.then: skip it: no chase
one more setup at most: gap days that fade take the small caps with them

playbook.if: a fill drops back under VWAP
playbook.then: out on the next bar; never average down
done for the day (rule 3a)

plan_c.note: Down 4% on the day: the tape isn't paying breakouts; stand aside

day.failsafe: Done after two losers or a 4% day loss (hard limit 6%); five trades at most; flat by 3:50 PM, no entries after 3:15.
lessons_applied: Not a rout morning (futures are up, VIX under 19), so clean range breaks are possible; the rout-day filter comes back if QQQ loses 680.

I still have only C$376 of cash, so the chip gap is not mine to chase: my rules wanted NVDA and KLAC yesterday and the mood sized both to zero. Lena already owns KLAC, which is +5.8% pre-market. My job is the exits: U at 47.50 goes first, then ABNB under 186. Time stops on the three earnings names are Nov 17.

options_aggr.view: Tuesday was my worst day: both calls stopped out, I re-bought a U call half an hour later and that stopped too. Three stops, -C$809, a halt at -20%, and my book is C$2,186. I own nothing now. The chip gap is tempting, but NVDA premium is rich six days before its report, and my lesson is cheaper strikes, not bigger bets. So: one trade at most today, small caps only if they prove it. IWM calls above 284, two contracts 3% out, and nothing if the gap fades. No name that stopped me out yesterday gets a second look today.

options_safe.view: I sold one put Tuesday: Rocket Companies December 11, strike 12.50, for C$0.24 a share, with the cash set aside. Rocket fell 4.9% to 14.45 on the hot CPI, so the put is marked against me at C$0.38, but the strike is 13.5% under the price and there are 30 days left. A mortgage lender with the 10-year near 5% is the risk I'm watching. I have C$773 of buying power left, which is not enough for a second put, so today I hold and sell nothing.
